installCommand: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.17.1 --activate && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
buildCommand: NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation pnpm --filter web-pwa build && rm -rf apps/api-core-python/.next && mkdir -p apps/api-core-python && cp -R apps/web-pwa/.next apps/api-core-python/.next
